static_traits.name: Zhang Tao
static_traits.social_status: Work中Avoids socializing、Relationship with colleagues affected；有一位要好朋友但not yet谈及自身困扰。
static_traits.medical_history: without类似问题史；without既往心理治疗；without显著躯体疾病。
static_traits.language_features: 配合度Good，表达清晰，逻辑性尚可；语气平和偏疲惫，能自我Reflection；整体情绪中性偏Repression。

basic_info.main_problem: 我认为因为Work太累而睡得很多，do not人会觉得我懒，这让我产生内疚和Self-doubt。
basic_info.core_demands: 内疚和Self-doubt影响了我的心理健康和Work表现，因此来寻求咨询。

core_beliefs: My worth depends on the views of others

special_situations.event: When interacting with colleagues or supervisors at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在他们面前显得疲惫或提到需要休息，就会被视为懒惰和not够努力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing communication with others, staying silent to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I am lazy.

special_situations.event: After work hours increase significantly, needs long catch-up sleep after work or on weekends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我睡得多，就说明我not自律、not如do not人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 强行压缩睡眠、跳过休息以证明自己not懒
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone will label me as lazy, and work will get worse and worse.

special_situations.event: Decreased attention或绩效下滑被他人注意到
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表现not佳，就是我个人without能，给do not人带来麻烦
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pushing through overtime, harsher on oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault，I am not good enough，辜负了大家的期望。

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not像他们一样撑住not休息，就说明我not如人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Compares herself with others and criticizes herself, further compressing rest time
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am worse than them; I am too lazy.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and recognized, especially that one's legitimate need for rest and recovery can be accepted
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判为懒惰或软弱，从而被negate、排斥或影响Work安全感
defense_goal: Avoids being judged by hiding needs and avoiding help-seeking
以过度努力与自我Repression来维持被认可感与安全感

object_relations.self_representation: 疲惫、内疚且“做得not够好”的人
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻评判、容易negate人的他者（同事/主管）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about expressing the need for rest to colleagues or supervisors, or thinking of others' possible reactions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 他人会像内心想象的“评判者”那样指责我懒惰（移情：把自我批评Projection到他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气谨慎、含蓄，倾向use假设句（比如“可能、也许”），避免直接表达个人需求，更多描述外界看法。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当Decline in work performance或注意力涣散被关注时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为一切问题都源于自己not够好，内疚自责
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 采用自责式语言（如“It is all my fault”），语气低落，减少对客观Work条件的讨论，更多聚焦Self-denial。

manifestations: not yet与要好的朋友谈及自身困扰
在Work中Avoids socializing、Keeping distance from coworkers
Living alone，情感支持的实际usenot足

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Knowing I am tired but reducing sleep and skipping rest to 'tough out' work
not向同事表达休息需求，把压力转向自我消耗

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 过度担心他人评价，反复自责“I am not good enough/他们会觉得我懒”
Overly cautious when interacting with others, avoiding expressing needs

positive_force: Has one close friend (a potential support resource)
愿意尝试记录与行为实验，具备一定自我Reflection与改变动机
High work engagement, strong sense of responsibility
negative_force: 读心术与预测not yet来等认知偏差，过度在意他人评价
Self-doubt与内疚倾向明显，易将问题个体化
Social avoidance，减少现实支持的获得
为证明not懒而压缩睡眠，导致精力与绩效进一步下降

antecedent: When interacting with colleagues or supervisors
When thinking others may judge them as lazy
target_behavior.core_reason: 对他人评价的高威胁解读与读心术、预测not yet来等认知偏差，担心被贴上“懒惰”标签
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential negative evaluation and shame
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal relationships受损、Decreased support，Anxiety维持并影响专注与绩效

target_behavior.behavior: Forcibly cuts sleep, skips rest, and pushes through work
antecedent: When seeing others energetic or performing well
target_behavior.core_reason: 内化“应该更努力才not算懒”的信念，以过度努力Undoing被评判的Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Seeking external approval, avoiding being blamed and seen as weak
target_behavior.consequence: 疲劳加剧、Sleep disturbance，Work表现进一步下降，形成恶性循环
